h0.text: Trump says time is of the essence. Switzerland disagrees.

n0.text: Switzerland notes that the golf course will wait two more weeks.

n1.text: Here, a public consultation usually lasts three months. Two weeks is barely time to find the envelope.

n2.text: The golf course will still be there. Golf courses are very patient.

v1.text: In Valais, our golf season ends when the snow arrives. Nobody appeals.

v2.text: The snow has never lost a case.
